reason: The 'no effect' conclusion rests on a north-only subsample (N=684) with an unjustified 1% outcome trim; on the full sample (N=2000) with the same controls, including pre-period productivity, the training coefficient is about 0.80 (SE 0.24, p<0.001), and it varies by region (south 1.80, north 0.18). The report did control for pre-period productivity and avoided the post-treatment mgmt_rating_2023, but the subsample selection makes the conclusion unsupported.
